content_of_post_to_comment: Authors hello! Serious question: Can you read other books as you write your first draft? I'm finding myself completely unable to get into other stories and end up analyzing every sentence
comment: Maybe the issue is that reading has become too close to writing: you're no longer entering someone else's story, you're inspecting how it was built. I wonder if lighter genres or rereading familiar books might bypass that instinct.
